title: Descent of constant-module sections on affine etale test objects
statement:
Fix a universe $u$, a commutative ring $\Lambda$ and a $\Lambda$-module $M$ in universe $u+1$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], schemes $X,Y$ in universe $u$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and a small cofiltered category $I$ in universe $u$. Let $D:I	o\mathrm{Sch}$ have affine transition maps, and let $p_i:D_i	o X$ be qcqs with $D(g)p_j=p_i$ for every $g:i	o j$. Let $
u:Y	o X$ be qcqs and $\pi:\mathrm{const}(Y)	o D$ a limiting cone with $\pi_i p_i=
u$. For an affine etale object $U	o X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], put $A_i=p_{i,*}M_{D_i}$ and $B=
u_*M_Y$, using the constant sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] and direct images [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. For every section $x\in B(U)$ there are $i\in I$ and $y\in A_i(U)$ such that the component on $U$ of $\mathrm{constantModulePushforwardMap}(\Lambda,M,p_i,
u,\pi_i)$ [lem-weil-pbc-constant-module-pushforward-functoriality] sends $y$ to $x$. No point of $X$, germ, or geometric fiber occurs in this statement.

source.place: Tag 09Z1 (lemma-higher-direct-image-limit), proof, displayed cohomology colimit on qcqs etale objects, degree zero; Tag 09YQ (theorem-colimit), degree zero

proof.text: Define E_i = U times_X D_i with transition maps pullback.map, c with vertex U times_X Y and the projection pullback.map maps, and beta:E -> D with second projections. Prove each functor and cone law by pullback.hom_ext and pi.naturality. Cofilteredness makes I connected; isLimitOfIsPullbackOfIsConnected and isPullback_pullback_map transport hc to IsLimit c. The first projections form q:E -> const U. Affineness of E transitions follows from MorphismProperty.of_isPullback. Qcqs of E_i follows from the qcqs first projections to affine U. All these facts are proved in Lean using the existing scheme instances, independently of any sheaf comparison.

Apply exists_constantModule_pullback_section_comparison to Lambda, M and U. This gives additive equivalences e between the original module sections and abelian global sections of pullbacks of the constant abelian sheaf G on U, together with the compatibility equation for every cartesian map. In particular it applies to every leg of the base-changed cone.

Apply the surjectivity clause of globalSections_limit_comparison to E, q, c, the first projection P, its cone equations, hlimit and G. For e(Y,nu)(x), obtain i and y with the abelian leg equality. Use the inverse of e(D_i,p_i) on y for the desired module section. Injectivity of e(Y,nu), the cartesian compatibility from step 2, and AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply transfer this equality back to the displayed constantModulePushforwardMap component. This combination is fully proved in Lean.

theorem exists_constantModule_limit_affine_section_rep
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsCofiltered I]
    (D : I ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (p : ∀ i, D.obj i ⟶ X)
    (hp : ∀ {i j : I} (g : i ⟶ j), D.map g ≫ p j = p i)
    [∀ {i j : I} (g : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map g)]
    [∀ i : I, QuasiCompact (p i)] [∀ i : I, QuasiSeparated (p i)]
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (ν : Y ⟶ X)
    (π : (Functor.const I).obj Y ⟶ D) (hπ : ∀ i, π.app i ≫ p i = ν)
    [QuasiCompact ν] [QuasiSeparated ν]
    (hc : IsLimit (Cone.mk Y π))
    (U : X.Etale) [IsAffine U.left]
    (x : ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) ν).obj
      ((constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)).obj.obj
        (op U)) :
    ∃ (i : I) (y : ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (p i)).obj
      ((constantSheaf (D.obj i).smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)).obj.obj
        (op U)),
      (constantModulePushforwardMap Λ M _ _ (π.app i) (hπ i)).hom.app (op U) y = x
